arxiv-2104-14778.title: Continuous black-box optimization with quantum annealing and random subspace coding
arxiv-2104-14778.creator: Syun Izawa, Koki Kitai, Shu Tanaka, Ryo Tamura, Koji Tsuda
arxiv-2104-14778.description: Abstract A black-box optimization algorithm such as Bayesian optimization finds extremum of an unknown function by alternating inference of the underlying function and optimization of an acquisition function. In a high-dimensional space, such algorithms perform poorly due to the difficulty of acquisition function optimization. Herein, we apply quantum annealing (QA) to overcome the difficulty in the continuous black-box optimization.

arxiv-2202-08200.title: Modelling multi-cell edge video analytics Thanks: This work has been submitted to IEEE for publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible.
arxiv-2202-08200.creator: Jaume Anguera Peris and Viktoria Fodor
arxiv-2202-08200.description: Abstract Edge intelligence is a scalable solution for analyzing distributed data, but it cannot provide reliable services in large-scale cellular networks unless the inherent aspects of fading and interference are also taken into consideration. In this paper, we present the first mathematical framework for modelling edge video analytics in multi-cell cellular systems.

arxiv-2303-12319.title: NeuronsMAE: A Novel Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Environment for Cooperative and Competitive Multi-Robot Tasks Thanks: G. Hu, S. liu, and M. Ma are with the School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing 100049, China, and also with the State Key Laborato
arxiv-2303-12319.creator: Guangzheng Hu, Haoran Li, Shasha Liu
arxiv-2303-12319.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Guangzheng Hu, Haoran Li, Shasha Liu. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has achieved remarkable success in various challenging problems. Meanwhile, more and more benchmarks have emerged and provided some standards to evaluate the algorithms in different fields. On the one hand, the virtual MARL environments lack knowledge of real-world tasks and actuator abilities, and on the other hand, the current task-specified multi-robot platform has poor support for the generality of multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithms and lacks support for transferring from simulation to the real environment.

arxiv-2307-15541.title: Dark matter via Baryogenesis: Affleck-Dine Mechanism in the Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model
arxiv-2307-15541.creator: K. El Bourakadi 1,2, M. Ferricha-Alami 1,2, Z. Sakhi 1,2, M. Bennai 1,2, H. Chakir 1,2
arxiv-2307-15541.description: Abstract We conducted an investigation into Affleck-Dine baryogenesis within the context of D-term inflation, specifically focusing on its relationship with a recent reheating formalism. It was found that by considering a specific reheating temperature, the observed baryon asymmetry can be accounted through Affleck-Dine baryogenesis.

arxiv-2310-17389.title: ToxicChat : Unveiling Hidden Challenges of Toxicity Detection in Real-World User-AI Conversation Warning: some contents may contain racism, sexuality, or other undesired contents.
arxiv-2310-17389.creator: Zi Lin Zihan Wang Yongqi Tong Yangkun Wang Yuxin Guo Yujia Wang Jingbo Shang {lzi, ziw224, yotong, yaw048, y5guo, yuw103, jshang}@ucsd.edu UC San Diego
arxiv-2310-17389.description: Abstract Despite remarkable advances that large language models have achieved in chatbots, maintaining a non-toxic user-AI interactive environment has become increasingly critical nowadays. However, previous efforts in toxicity detection have been mostly based on benchmarks derived from social media content, leaving the unique challenges inherent to real-world user-AI interactions insufficiently explored.

arxiv-2402-04747.title: Non-uniformly continuous nearest point maps
arxiv-2402-04747.creator: Rubén Medina, Andrés Quilis
arxiv-2402-04747.description: Abstract . We construct a Banach space satisfying that the nearest point map (also called proximity mapping or metric projection) onto any compact and convex subset is continuous but not uniformly continuous. The space we construct is locally uniformly convex, which ensures the continuity of all these nearest point maps.

arxiv-2407-07246.title: Coordinating “7 Billion Humans” is hard
arxiv-2407-07246.creator: Alessandro Panconesi, Pietro Maria Posta, Mirko Giacchini
arxiv-2407-07246.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alessandro Panconesi, Pietro Maria Posta, Mirko Giacchini. In the video game “7 Billion Humans”, the player is requested to direct a group of workers to various destinations by writing a program that is executed simultaneously on each worker. While the game is quite rich and, indeed, it is considered one of the best games for beginners to learn the basics of programming, we show that even extremely simple versions are already NP-Hard or PSPACE-Hard.

arxiv-2502-12129.title: When Wyner and Ziv Met Bayes in Quantum-Classical Realm
arxiv-2502-12129.creator: Mohammad Aamir Sohail 1 , Touheed Anwar Atif 2 , and S. Sandeep Pradhan 1
arxiv-2502-12129.description: Abstract In this work, we address the lossy quantum-classical source coding with the quantum side-information (QC-QSI) problem. The task is to compress the classical information about a quantum source, obtained after performing a measurement while incurring a bounded reconstruction error.

arxiv-2503-21184.description: Abstract Aditya-L1, India’s first dedicated mission to study the Sun and its atmosphere from the Sun-Earth Lagrangian L1 location was successfully launched on 2023 September 2. It carries seven payloads. The Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) is a major payload on Aditya-L1.

arxiv-2504-02526.title: Improving User Experience with FAICO: Towards a Framework for AI Communication in Human-AI Co-Creativity
arxiv-2504-02526.creator: Jeba Rezwana, Corey Ford
arxiv-2504-02526.description: Abstract . How AI communicates with humans is crucial for effective human-AI co-creation. However, many existing co-creative AI tools cannot communicate effectively, limiting their potential as collaborators. This paper introduces our initial design of a Framework for designing AI Communication (FAICO) for co-creative AI based on a systematic review of 107 full-length papers.

arxiv-2507-01968.title: Optimising task allocation to balance business goals and worker well-being for financial service workforces Journal: Journal of Modelling in Management (accepted)
arxiv-2507-01968.creator: Christopher Duckworth, Zlatko Zlatev, James Sciberras, Peter Hallett, Enrico Gerding
arxiv-2507-01968.description: Abstract Purpose Financial service companies manage huge volumes of data which requires timely error identification and resolution. The associated tasks to resolve these errors frequently put financial analyst workforces under significant pressure leading to resourcing challenges and increased business risk. To address this challenge, we introduce a formal task allocation model which considers both business orientated goals and analyst well-being.

pmc-11624018.title: From Injury to Innovation: Margaret Dix’s Pioneering Work in Neuro-Otology
pmc-11624018.creator: L Stefano Ramirez-Gil, Cecilia Belen Espinosa-Arce
pmc-11624018.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Margaret Ruth Dix made groundbreaking contributions to neuro-otology, particularly in the study of vestibular disorders. Together with Charles Hallpike, Dix developed the Dix-Hallpike maneuver, a diagnostic technique that is still widely used today for benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV). Their research provided critical insights into BPPV, although they initially misidentified its cause, attributing it to otolithic disturbances instead of semicircular canal dysfunction.

pmc-12560294.title: Early psycho-social support of pregnant women at risk for preeclampsia and fetal intrauterine growth restriction
pmc-12560294.creator: Franziska Epple, Jörg Reichert, Mario Rüdiger, Cahit Birdir, Lars Mense
pmc-12560294.description: BackgroundThe risk of preeclampsia and intrauterine growth restriction can be assessed in the first trimester combining maternal characteristics, biophysical and biochemical measurements.
